title: AP Advisor Generated Content
description: Output shape for one generated AP Precalculus / Calculus AB / Calculus BC learning item. Reviews and study plans use their own human-readable formats.

course.description: Course key used by the citation validator.

unit.description: Unit number from the validated citation, e.g. 'Unit 2'.

topic.description: Topic code and catalog title from the validator, without scope markers, e.g. '2.4 Exponential Function Manipulation'.

topic_exam_scope.description: Topic-level scope recorded in the bundled catalog. This does not certify that the generated content satisfies every AP Exam learning objective, exclusion, format, or calculator condition.

type.description: The kind of content being generated.

difficulty.description: Cognitive and prerequisite demand, independent of AP-oriented style.

style.description: ap-oriented means original course-shaped practice, not official College Board material or proof of full exam alignment.

catalog_match.description: The unit/topic citation exactly matches the bundled catalog.

automated_status.description: Whether the bundled citation validator ran successfully. not_run requires an exact manual catalog lookup.

supporting_topics.description: Optional validated supporting catalog topics materially used by the item.

content.description: Type-specific body. Required sub-fields depend on the value of 'type'.

principle.description: Required for type=explanation. Core concept/rule explained first, before any application.

real_world_application.description: Optional for type=explanation. A concrete scenario when it materially clarifies the principle.

final_answer.description: Optional concise answer for a practice problem when the user requests an answer or answer key.

solution.description: Required for type=worked_example and optional for type=practice_problem. Full worked reasoning, not just the final answer.

common_mistake.description: Optional topic-specific pitfall without an unsupported prevalence claim.
